Subject: Snowline Scout - joint demo dry run and contingency stitch

Hi Naomi,

Thanks again for the intro call last week. Snowline and our SI (Priya/Shah) would like to run a coordinated dry run before the marketplace co-sell demo next week so we can validate:
- upstream SSO and SCIM for the marketplace listing
- data-path through Redwood Dedicated (staging) to verify latency at 512 tokens
- fallback host and recording plan (APAC attendees may join live)

Proposed dry-run windows (PT) are Wed Aug 4: 10:00-11:00 or 15:00-16:00. The technical playbook we need to validate is attached (snowline-requirements.docx). Can you please loop in the Redwood ops lead for staging access and confirm a primary + backup host? Also confirm whether token-level logs will be available for the rehearsal.

We'd like a short contingency plan documented (who falls to backup host if network glitch) and an ops contact for post-dry-run notes.

Regards,
Alex Torres
Partnerships | Snowline Scout
alex.torres@snowline.com

Subject: Re: Snowline Scout - joint demo dry run and contingency stitch

Hi Alex — thanks for sending this over. Confirming that Redwood can host a dry run in staging and we can supply token-level tracing for the rehearsal window. A few quick asks so we can lock the runbook: 

1) Please confirm primary presenter and backup presenter (name, email, phone).
2) Which model variant do you want pinned in staging (we recommend redwood/llama-13b-q4 for this use case to match perf tests)?
3) Do you need a recording + cloud storage access for the recording (we can push to your S3 if you provide a temp role)?

For timing, Connor and I prefer the 15:00-16:00 PT slot (gives our APAC SI time to join and gives ops time to prepare after morning sync). I attached our current runbook (runbook_v3.pdf) and a slide deck stub — please review and highlight any step you want trimmed.

If 15:00 PT works, Connor will seed the calendar invite and we'll provision a dedicated staging endpoint (redwood-dedicated-stg-001). We'll also include the fallback host details in the runbook (ops will point to an alternate regional pool).

Next steps: Alex confirm presenters + model; Priya confirm any SI-side test data or scripts.

Thanks,
Naomi Feldman
Head of Partner GTM | Redwood Inference
naomi@redwood.com

Attachments: runbook_v3.pdf (pdf, 128 KB), redwood-slide-deck-v2.pptx (pptx, 2.3 MB)

+1 on the 15:00-16:00 PT slot — ops checked capacity and the staging GPU pool is clear after 14:00 PT. A couple of operational notes: 
- We'll pin the model SHA to redwood/llama-13b-q4:20270801 so behavior matches perf runs.
- Connor will provision a short-lived API key for the SI team; Priya, we need your preferred IP ranges for the A/C firewall rule.
- I'll add an "escalation rope" to the runbook: 1) on-call infra, 2) fallback host (us-west-2 spare pod), 3) recording toggle.

Connor — can you create the calendar invite with a Google Meet link and add the staging endpoint and the postmortem doc link? Alex — we'll expect the SI test script (simple prompt set + dataset) before EOD Wed so we can sanity-check caches.
